description: This file defines middleware for exception handling in an ASP.NET Core web application, specifically handling exceptions and returning appropriate JSON error responses.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware component for catching exceptions during HTTP request processing and generating JSON error responses.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware method that processes the HTTP context and handles exceptions asynchronously.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Helper method to generate an error response based on exception type, setting HTTP status codes and response content.
